user.title: Setup Blueprints Updater
user.description: Do you want to setup Blueprints Updater? It will scan your local blueprints and look for updates.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of Blueprints Updater is allowed.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Configure the behavior and settings for Blueprints Updater.

options.auto_fix: Review and apply modernization patch (Auto Fix)
options.unpin: Unpin blueprint and resume upstream tracking

reload.name: Reload blueprints
reload.description: Scans all local blueprints for new files and checks for updates immediately.

restore_blueprint.name: Restore Blueprint
restore_blueprint.description: Restores a blueprint from a numbered backup file (.bak.1, .bak.2, etc.) if available.

entity_id.name: Blueprint Entity
entity_id.description: The update entity of the blueprint you want to restore.

version.name: Backup Version
version.description: Which backup version to restore (1 = newest, 2 = older, etc.)

update_all.name: Update All Blueprints
update_all.description: Automatically downloads and installs all available blueprint updates simultaneously.

backup.name: Create Backup
backup.description: Create numbered backup files for all updated blueprints before overwriting.

import_blueprint.name: Import Blueprint
import_blueprint.description: Downloads and installs a blueprint from a URL.

url.name: Blueprint URL
url.description: The URL of the blueprint. Supports direct YAML links or provider URLs (GitHub, GitHub Gist, Home Assistant Community, GitLab, Codeberg, Bitbucket).

confirm.name: Confirm External Source
confirm.description: Required to acknowledge importing from external/unverified sources.

init.title: Resolve Withdrawn Blueprint
init.description: The blueprint {name} ({path}) was withdrawn from {source_url}. What would you like to do?

menu_options.stop_tracking: Keep local copy and stop tracking

change_url.title: Update Source URL
change_url.description: Enter a new source URL for {name} ({path}).

confirm_risks.title: Review Changes

delete_blueprint.title: Delete Blueprint
delete_blueprint.description:
Are you sure you want to delete {name} ({path})?

Currently used by {usage_count} entity(ies): {entities}.{take_control_tip}

data.confirm_delete_in_use: I understand this will break dependent automations/scripts

error.confirmation_required: Confirmation is required to delete a blueprint in use.
error.usage_discovery_failed: Unable to determine blueprint usage. Please try again.

auto_fix.title: Preview Modernization Patch

acknowledge.title: Acknowledge Compatibility Warning
acknowledge.description:
You are dismissing this deprecation warning for **{name}** (`{path}`).

This warning is scheduled to become a breaking error in Home Assistant {breaks_in_ha_version}. If you update Home Assistant to a new version or edit the blueprint file, the warning will be automatically re-evaluated.

change_url.title: Switch to Community Fork
change_url.description:
Enter the URL of an updated community fork for **{name}** (`{path}`).

To preserve existing automations without breaking them, the blueprint remains at its current filesystem path (`{relative_path}`) while updates will track the new URL.

confirm_fork.title: Confirm Fork Switch

unpin.title: Unpin Blueprint
unpin.description:
Are you sure you want to unpin **{name}** (`{path}`)?

This will resume tracking the upstream author ({source_url}) and allow auto-updates.

error.fork_breaking_error: This fork fails Home Assistant {ha_version} validation: {error}

abort.file_changed: Blueprint file was modified before the patch could be applied: {error}
abort.apply_success: Modernization patch applied successfully and blueprint pinned.
abort.fork_applied: Blueprint tracking switched to fork successfully.

missing_backup.message: Missing backup file. A backup may not have been created during the previous update.

no_coordinator.message: No active coordinator found. Please check integration setup.

confirmation_required.message: Importing from external sources requires explicit confirmation. Please check the 'Confirm' box.

unsupported_source.message: Unsupported source. Only GitHub, GitHub Gist, Home Assistant Community, GitLab, Codeberg, Bitbucket, and direct YAML links are supported.

import_path_conflict.message: A blueprint with this name already exists from a different source ({existing_url}). Please remove it first to avoid conflicts.

invalid_content_type.message: Invalid content type: {content_type}. Expected text/plain or YAML.

invalid_yaml.message: The imported file is not a valid YAML blueprint.
